fields.Name: Multi-Dimensional Engagement Scoring
fields.Description: Skip analytics conversation from the More Cheese suite

fields.Message: Create an engagement score for all active members using these weighted factors: event attendance (30%), course completion (25%), chapter leadership (20%), committee participation (15%), and years as member (10%). Show the top 20 members in a ranked table. When I click on a member, show me a breakdown chart (pie or bar) of how each factor contributed to their score. Then let me click on any factor in that chart to see the actual underlying activities or data for that dimension. [NO CHAT]

Awesome, your Member Engagement Score Leaderboard is ready. It ranks your top 20 active members using the exact 5-factor weighted formula across events, courses, leadership roles, committees, and tenure. You can click any member to explore their score contribution chart, toggle between progress bars and a donut view, and drill down into the underlying activity audit records for each dimension.
